sentences.text: Heterorhea was an extinct genus of ratites belonging to the rhea family.
The type species of the genus is Heterorhea dabbenei.
The genus Heterorhea was described by Rovereto in 1914.
Unfortunately, the holotype specimen for the genus Heterorhea is missing.
This animal lived between 5 and 3.8 million years ago during the Zanclean age.
Fossils of Heterorhea have been found in the Late Pliocene Monte Hermoso Formation in Buenos Aires, Argentina.
